items.name: terse
items.description: [![inth3shadows/terse MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/inth3shadows/terse/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/inth3shadows/terse)      - Transparent proxy that sits in front of any other MCP server and shrinks its tool output before it reaches the model. Lossless by default — a denser encoding of the same bytes, with a round-trip gate asserting an exact inverse, so nothing is dropped or summarised. Repeated calls to the same tool emit a delta against the prior result instead of the whole payload. Per-tool opt-in, no decode step, no model in the loop. `uv tool install terse-mcp` then `terse proxy -- <server>`

Attaches over `chrome.debugger` to the Chrome you're already logged into (cookies, MFA and SSO already done) and turns the live page into a short numbered interaction graph an agent can act on (`[03] button 'Sign In'`), with CSS selectors kept server-side and out of the model's context.
